remarks: Rare opportunity to experience refined living in this unique end-unit townhouse within Wilton Crest. Flooded with natural light, the home boasts airy, well-appointed interiors. A vaulted living room, complete with hardwood floors and a fireplace, seamlessly extends to a private deck offering serene pond views - ideal for relaxation or entertaining. The gourmet kitchen, featuring premium appliances and Corian counters, connects effortlessly to a bright dining space. Retreat to the primary suite with its private courtyard access and a luxurious, spa-inspired en-suite bath. A second spacious bedroom also includes a full private bathroom for guest comfort. The expansive, unfinished lower level provides unlimited potential for customization, from a home office to a media room. This low-maintenance residence combines comfort and convenience in a tranquil setting, a truly rare find.
